_comment: Data-driven consistency rules for Register Inspector's rule engine (docs/register_inspector_plan.md Bolum 1b). Field/register names are matched against SVD names, so a rule only fires for peripherals that actually have that exact register/field — no per-family code branches. All names below were verified against the shipped STM32F407.svd and STM32H723.svd (see docs/register_inspector_findings.md-style verification in the Bolum 1 implementation notes).
_scopeNote: MVP is deliberately limited to within-peripheral field/register relationships. Cross-peripheral rules (e.g. 'DMA stream enabled but the requesting peripheral's DMA-request bit is off', or GPIO alternate-function-vs-peripheral-usage consistency) are NOT included: STM32 DMA stream registers are per-stream (S0CR..S7CR on F4/H7-style DMA), and a single exact-name rule would silently only ever check stream 0 — misleading rather than useful. This needs pattern/wildcard register-name matching, which the engine does not support yet. Left as documented future work.

rules.message: {peripheral}: {ifField}=1 (sayaç çalışıyor) ama {thenRegister}=0 (auto-reload sıfır — sayaç anında taşabilir)
